rule: A failed orchestration, packaging or source/image compatibility attempt is not evidence that DRRQR fails.

failures.symptom: A literal plus sign from a malformed patch reached the shell script.
failures.recovery: Repair with a structured patch, run shell syntax/static checks, then relaunch under the same frozen experiment identity.

failures.symptom: Collapsed line continuations produced an invalid Docker image reference.
failures.recovery: Use Bash argument arrays for docker run instead of continuation-sensitive command assembly.

failures.symptom: PEP 517 dependency resolution attempted unavailable triton-ascend==3.2.2.
failures.recovery: Use the image-compatible minimal install path without dependency resolution.

failures.symptom: Mounting a newer worktree gdn.py into the frozen image failed to import vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.
failures.recovery: Keep the frozen image's compatible GDN implementation and inject only the minimal bounded capture hook.

failures.symptom: The initial converter assumed linear-attention layers were numbered contiguously 0-47.
failures.evidence: Qwen3.6-27B has 64 transformer layers; every fourth layer is full attention, so the 48 linear-attention IDs are non-contiguous.
failures.recovery: Derive and validate the exact linear layer IDs from text_config.layer_types before mapping captures or mutating tensors.

failures.symptom: Continuation collapse again produced an invalid Docker reference.
failures.recovery: Replace the launch command with a Bash array; the repaired smoke later exited 0 and is the accepted attempt.

failures.symptom: git diff --check reported 'Not a git repository' when the remote executor did not honor the requested cwd.
failures.recovery: Pass explicit --git-dir=/cache/cch/vllm-ascend/.git/worktrees/WS-20260904-qwen38-dense-paper-to-ascend and --work-tree=/cache/cch/.worktrees/WS-20260904-qwen38-dense-paper-to-ascend; diff --check then exits 0.

failures.symptom: A complete shell command was initially passed as the executable name and failed with spawn: No such file.
failures.experiment_impact: none; the authoritative controller remained live and was not restarted
failures.recovery: Invoke /bin/sh with -lc and pass the shell line as a separate argument.

failures.symptom: The first validation invocation omitted the required --root argument and exited 2.
failures.experiment_impact: none; raw artifacts were not changed
failures.recovery: Rerun with the exact output root and --allow-incomplete while required treatment/profile artifacts are still absent.

failures.symptom: The first read-only validation script requested output_throughput_tok_s and duration_s, while the recorded schema uses output_tokens_per_second and benchmark_duration_s; it exited 1 after reading baseline rows.
failures.experiment_impact: none; all six raw performance JSON files remained unchanged
failures.recovery: Inspect the actual summary keys and rerun the validator with the recorded field names; corrected validation exited 0 and verified every run as 40/40 with exact 1024-token outputs.

failures.symptom: An interim handoff edit initially used a manually rounded observation time instead of an authoritative host timestamp.
failures.experiment_impact: none; no raw artifact, request or controller state was changed
failures.recovery: Read UTC time from the target host, replace the rounded value with 2026-09-06T23:31:02Z, and describe the asynchronously increasing row count as a verified lower bound rather than an exact current count.

failures.symptom: Invoking the converter with host python3 --help imported numpy before argparse and exited because numpy is absent on the host.
failures.experiment_impact: none; no destination directory existed and no checkpoint file was written
failures.classification: host dependency mismatch during read-only CLI discovery
failures.recovery: Run the same script in the frozen vLLM Ascend image mounted on /cache; --help exited 0 and exposed the exact converter arguments.

failures.symptom: The first combined shell command embedded literal backslash-n sequences in python3 -c and exited with SyntaxError before reading artifacts.
failures.measurement_started: all Dk64 measurements were already complete
failures.experiment_impact: none; the command was read-only and subsequent independent checks found every raw artifact unchanged
failures.recovery: Pass the multiline Python program as a direct argument rather than through shell interpolation; rerun independently alongside container and NPU4-7 release checks.

failures.symptom: Operation exec-0000000000000c15 exited 2 after 20 ms because the submitted path inserted a nonexistent scripts directory before state_reduction_formal_runner.py.
failures.experiment_impact: none; no container, dataset row or raw measurement was started or changed, and NPU4-7 remained empty
failures.recovery: Verify the runner with test -f, confirm no matching controller and no process on NPU4-7, then launch the same frozen quality phase from the actual workstream path as operation exec-0000000000000c1b.

failures.stage: incomplete final-report rendering during Dk96 quality
failures.symptom: A newly added raw-quality table iterated over GSM8K before the three Dk96 GSM8K aggregate existed and raised KeyError.
failures.measurement_started: the independent quality controller remained live
failures.experiment_impact: none; the command only read accepted artifacts and attempted to overwrite derived summary/report files
failures.recovery: Render raw dataset tables only when both baseline and candidate three-run aggregates exist, then rerun py_compile, allow-incomplete rendering and diff checks.

failures.symptom: The first read-only handoff validator assumed a nonexistent top-level state_reduction key and exited with KeyError.
failures.experiment_impact: none; the command only parsed task.json and did not modify raw or derived experiment artifacts
failures.recovery: Enumerate the actual task.json keys, select state_reduction_piercing explicitly, and rerun the same read-only consistency and hash checks.
